{"script":"set -e

# Choose an install location in PATH.
target=
if [ -d /usr/local/bin ] && [ -w /usr/local/bin ]; then
  target=/usr/local/bin/count
else
  IFS=:
  for d in $PATH; do
    if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -d "$d" ] && [ -w "$d" ]; then
      target="$d/count"
      break
    fi
  done
  unset IFS
fi

[ -n "$target" ]

cat > "$target" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  printf 'Usage: count DIR\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

dir=$1
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  printf 'count: %s: not a directory\n' "$dir" >&2
  exit 1
fi
case $dir in
  -*) dir=./$dir ;;
esac

n=$(find -P "$dir" \( -type f -o -type l \) -printf . | wc -c)
printf '%s\n' "${n//[[:space:]]/}"
EOF
chmod 755 "$target"

# Short self-test.
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$tmp/sub"
: > "$tmp/a"
: > "$tmp/sub/b"
ln "$tmp/a" "$tmp/h"
ln -s "$tmp/a" "$tmp/s"
out=$("$target" "$tmp")
rm -rf "$tmp"
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$target" "$out""}
